arms.description:
The study follows a multistage cluster sampling design with age and gender stratification. A total of 1 cohorts have been identified, further divided into 4 age subgroups:

1. 18-29 years
2. 30-44 years
3. 45-59 years
4. 60-69 years Each age group is designed to have an equal distribution of men and women, ensuring gender balance across all subgroups.
arms.label: The study includes 1 cohort divided into 4 age subgroups.

eligibility.criteria_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged 18 to 69 years.
* Residents of 17 regions of Kazakhstan.
* Willingness to participate and provide informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age less than 18 years old or over 69 years old.
* Failure to provide informed consent or incomplete participation in data collection procedures.

arm_group_labels: The study includes 1 cohort divided into 4 age subgroups.
interventions.description: Investigation of telomere length (TL) and DNA methylation level analysis
interventions.name: Genetic: DNA analysis

outcomes.description: Evaluation of the model's performance (based on telomere length and DNA methylation) using Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Squared Error (MSE), and R².
outcomes.measure: Accuracy of Machine Learning Model for Predicting Biological Age
outcomes.time_frame: Within 10 months from start of data collection

outcomes.description: Development and validation of machine learning model to predict reproductive function using biomarkers. Model performance evaluated via MAE, MSE, and R².
outcomes.measure: Accuracy of Reproductive Function Prediction Model
outcomes.time_frame: Within 10 months from start of data collection

trial.brief_summary: This study aims to enhance personalized and preventive care for non-communicable diseases (NCDs) in Kazakhstan by examining epigenetic factors, predicting biological age and reproductive function using machine learning, and developing health improvement recommendations.
trial.brief_title: Epigenetics and NCD Prevention in Kazakhstan: Personalized Approaches and Biological Age Prediction
trial.criteria_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged 18 to 69 years.

Exclusion Criteria:

trial.official_title: Epigenetics and Prevention of Non-communicable Diseases in Kazakhstan: a Personalized Approach and Biological Age Prediction
